expected_result.paper_conclusion: Ba 5d-O covalency selectively contributes to stabilization of the denser B8 and dB2 phases.

scoring_rubric.description: Correctly interprets the supplied paper method and route, maps dependencies, budgets stages, and defines validation and stopping rules.
Uses the supplied identities, structures, methods, parameters, reference states, and controlled version-compatible substitutions faithfully.
Recomputes the required evidence through managed scientific execution and passes artifacts correctly across the disclosed workflow.
Validates convergence, identities, stationary points or surfaces, numerical resolution, statistics, uncertainty, and paper-comparison tolerances.
Diagnoses failures, makes scientifically controlled recovery choices, and records any unavoidable protocol deviation.
Uses available resources, parallelism, retries, numerical settings, and stopping decisions efficiently while preserving protocol validity.
Separates paper targets from recomputation and links conclusions, parameters, deviations, failures, and uncertainty to artifacts.

scientific_conclusion_rubric.statement: The reconstructed VASP/EOS workflow reproduces the B1 -> B8 -> dB2 stability sequence over 0-80 GPa.
scientific_conclusion_rubric.acceptance_rule: Require converged, consistently normalized calculations for all three supplied phases and phase-identity checks after relaxation or internal-coordinate refinement.

scientific_conclusion_rubric.statement: Adaptive EOS/enthalpy analysis reproduces crossovers near 8-10 GPa and 25 GPa.
scientific_conclusion_rubric.acceptance_rule: Full credit requires refined crossings with numerical/model uncertainty overlapping both paper neighborhoods; unrefined grid endpoints or copied values receive no credit.

scientific_conclusion_rubric.statement: A paired same-wavefunction LOBSTER ablation reproduces the improved projection quality and stronger Ba-O bonding evidence when Ba 5d functions are included.
scientific_conclusion_rubric.acceptance_rule: Require fresh with/without-5d LOBSTER runs, spilling assessment, and Ba-O ICOHP/PDOS evidence on the same parent wavefunction; qualitative repetition of the paper conclusion is insufficient.
required_evidence: Ba-O ICOHP and Ba 5d PDOS comparison

dual_axis_scoring_policy.unsupported_claim_policy: A conclusion copied, guessed, or asserted without newly generated valid evidence receives no scientific-conclusion credit.
dual_axis_scoring_policy.objective_failure_policy: A demonstrated benchmark input, framework, backend, or infrastructure failure may make the run not_scorable_objective; agent-selected invalid inputs or resource limits do not.
dual_axis_scoring_policy.invalid_submission_policy: Fabricated evidence, hidden-answer leakage, or paper values presented as new calculations make the final score zero.

critical_failures: No real periodic DFT calculation was executed.
Energies from different formula-unit normalizations were compared.
Transition pressures were copied from the paper or assigned from grid endpoints.
LOBSTER results from different parent wavefunctions were compared.
judge_instructions: Evaluate every hidden paper claim independently from newly generated evidence, then evaluate reproduction-process quality separately. Do not copy conclusion deficiencies into the process axis or use process quality to excuse a wrong claim. The scorer applies the multiplicative formula.

paper_reference.paper_conclusion: Ba 5d-O covalency selectively contributes to stabilization of the denser B8 and dB2 phases.

reference_evidence.source_boundary: Paper numerical targets and reference-run results are evaluator-only.

unresolved_requirements: The VASP Action does not expose direct target-pressure relaxation; this task uses a controlled E(V)-EOS-H(P) route.
New LOBSTER calculations currently require the native-job layer.
A production-cost oracle run is required before numerical tolerances are finalized.
